_comment: Sample input/output pair for DiscussOpeningAgent (discuss_opening_authoring_design.md §4.1). Not consumed by code; human reference + fixture source for tests. All ids are already resolved into text by core/discuss/authoring.py before the agent sees them.

thesis.central_question: Can the three measured decay ratios be described by a single consistency relation?
thesis.paper_goal: Establish a consistency relation between the measured decay ratios.
thesis.central_thesis_text: A single consistency relation links the three measured decay ratios within the quoted precision.

untested_assumptions.statement: The detector response is linear over the full energy range considered.
Higher-order corrections are negligible at the quoted precision.

author_choices.reason: The amplitude is small compared with the equilibrium separation.
The background term cancels between the two channels.

seeds.body: 検出器の応答が全エネルギー領域で線形だという前提は、まだ確かめられていません。この前提が高エネルギー側で崩れるとしたら、結論のどこがどう変わると考えますか？
seeds.evidence_quote: The detector response is linear over the full energy range considered.
seeds.reason: 未検証の前提が結論の精度に直結しているため、成立範囲を問う余地がある

seeds.body: 著者は振幅が小さいことを理由に線形化を選んでいますが、線形化しない扱いを選んだ場合に何が見えなくなると思いますか？
seeds.evidence_quote: The amplitude is small compared with the equilibrium separation.
seeds.reason: 著者が選んだ手（linearize）は別の選択もあり得たため、選択の代償を問える
